amocrm.info: Log into your CRM as an administrator, create a long-lived access token (Settings → Integrations → API), then paste your account address and the token below and press Connect. Every finished call will be attached to the matching contact by phone number, with a recording link.
amocrm.responsibleUserId: Default responsible (amoCRM user ID) — for operators without a mapping

bitrix24.info: Create an inbound webhook in your Bitrix24 (Developer resources → Other → Inbound webhook) with the 'telephony' and 'crm' permissions, then paste it below. Calls are registered via telephony.externalcall; Bitrix24 creates a lead for unknown numbers, and the recording is attached to the call or posted to the CRM timeline.
bitrix24.regionLabel: Choose the connection type, depending on your Bitrix24 national version.
bitrix24.regionByKz: Belarusian and Kazakhstani accounts — bitrix24.by, bitrix24.kz
bitrix24.userId: Default Bitrix24 user ID — for operators without a mapping (usually 1)
bitrix24.mapHint: Each operator's calls are registered to the chosen Bitrix24 user; unmapped operators use the default ID. Saved together with the Connect button.
bitrix24.usersError: Couldn't load Bitrix24 users: {error}. Enter user IDs manually (or add the “user” scope to the webhook).
bitrix24.saveExternal: Save calls made outside Bitrix24 (create a card)
bitrix24.modeSimple: Portal mode: without leads (simple CRM) — no leads are created
bitrix24.modeAssumed: Portal mode not detected — no leads are created, to be safe
bitrix24.card_autoHint: Classic portal — a lead; portal without leads — a contact and a deal
bitrix24.card_leadHint: A lead is created for every new number
bitrix24.card_leadNoLeads: This portal doesn't create leads — a contact is created instead
bitrix24.card_contactHint: A contact is created for a new number
bitrix24.card_dealHint: A contact and a linked deal are created
bitrix24.card_noneHint: The call is saved in Bitrix24 without a card
bitrix24.knownNumberNote: If the number is already in the CRM, the call is attached to the existing card — no duplicate is created.
bitrix24.leadSourceHint: Bitrix24 source code: only A–Z, 0–9 and _ (up to 50 characters). Empty — CALL.
bitrix24.c2cIntro: Clicking a number in Bitrix24 starts the call from the operator's phone via DooCall (the operator confirms on the phone).

bitrix24.c2cWebhookStep: In Bitrix24 create an outgoing webhook with this URL for the ONEXTERNALCALLSTART event and paste the application_token it gives below.

odoo.info: 1) Download the DooCall app for Odoo 19 using the button below, extract it into your addons folder and install it (Apps → DooCall). 2) Create an API key in Odoo (Preferences → Account Security → API Keys) for an administrator user (only it writes records; data is read-only for everyone else) and fill the fields below. With the app every call shows inside the contact/lead with an audio player; without it, only a chatter note is posted.

kotib.info: Kotib Analytics analyses answered calls with AI. Get the API key in your Kotib cabinet (API settings) and enter it below. After saving, operators and calls are synced automatically — a test call should appear in Kotib within 5–10 minutes. If you rotate the key in Kotib, save the new one here again.
kotib.inactiveWarning: Inactive operators: {count}. They were created inactive because the operator limit of your Kotib plan is reached, and their calls are not analysed — activate them in your Kotib cabinet.
kotib.analysisUrlHint: Send this address and the blocks you need to your Kotib manager.

kotib.secretStored: Saved: {masked} — enter a new one to replace it
kotib.unsignedWarning: No signing secret set — results are accepted unsigned. Enter the signing secret from Kotib.
kotib.rotateConfirm: Regenerate the address? The old one stops working — you will need to send the new one to your Kotib manager.

landing.integrationsText: DooCall connects to popular CRM systems: calls and recordings land in your CRM automatically.
landing.heroSubtitle: dooCall records every call your operators make, stores it and turns it into reports. SIM card, app — done.
landing.step1Text: Install the dooCall app on the operator's phone and sign in.
landing.step2Text: Every inbound and outbound call is recorded automatically.
landing.step3Text: Recordings, stats and reports in the cabinet, in real time.
landing.fDashboardText: The day at a glance: who talked, what was missed.
landing.fCallsText: Every recording with audio — filters, search, export.
landing.fContactsText: A client base linked to call history.
landing.fReportsText: By periods, employees, clients and unanswered calls.
landing.fSettingsText: Operators, devices, integrations — in one place.
landing.fSecurityText: Recordings in encrypted storage; access is yours alone.

landing.faq2a: On servers in Uzbekistan, encrypted. Only you and people you authorize can listen.
landing.faq3a: Payme, Click or bank transfer. The price scales with operator count.
landing.faq4a: The account pauses, your data stays. Pay and everything reopens.
